InvokeAI ER-SDE scheduler

This directory contains an unmodified copy of
invokeai/backend/rectified_flow/er_sde_scheduler.py from InvokeAI commit
9e1540962bcca7f8fa668d7d8e02cf79d75fda3b:
https://github.com/invoke-ai/InvokeAI/blob/9e1540962bcca7f8fa668d7d8e02cf79d75fda3b/invokeai/backend/rectified_flow/er_sde_scheduler.py

Source SHA-256:
3c18bd6a847fcf0ecf0a6b67c37744546dc4dfbb88a0595915fe2391d437fbd7

Attribution: InvokeAI contributors. Distributed under Apache License 2.0;
the upstream license is included as LICENSE-InvokeAI.txt.

The original module retains its ER-SDE paper and reference implementation
attribution:
https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.06169
https://github.com/QinpengCui/ER-SDE-Solver
The reference repository's MIT notice is included as LICENSE-ER-SDE-Solver.txt.

Only ImageGen Studio's typed Anima flow wrapper selects the admitted configuration.
Third-party VP-SDE modes are not public ImageGen Studio model-family support.
The vendor file is excluded narrowly from local style/type rewriting to preserve
its exact upstream bytes. Application policy and integration wrappers remain
under the project's normal checks. Independent numerical tests load the pinned
external Invoke source and compare actual execution, not this copy as its oracle.
